goals.title: Which change to the review practice lets a budget-bound run end on a reviewed candidate without going on and on?
goals.body:
Design record for issue #141, part of #113. A run of a build Goal stopped twice with its last candidate commit unreviewed (G-ZBM2RE, runs 1 and 2), and run 3 spent each review on one more small commit. This Goal compares rival changes to the review practice of hyp-goal-run and the stop clause hyp prompt prints, and selects one or a combination. It builds nothing: the change to skills/ and internal/ is a later build Goal, which also carries the rule that hyp-goal-run states how a review is recorded and whether it counts against the budget.
The candidate is a rule, measured by replaying Sonnet runs from two starting points: the cut after R-8JQPWG (run 1, one Result left, a fix commit pending) and the cut after R-3YJ7T2 (run 2, one Result left, two limits whose cases pass). 3 trials per rival and per cut. The rivals are all under one question; H-whole-candidate is expected to lose on cost and is tested, not assumed.
May change: this tree's .tree/ and its evidence, in commits on one local branch; scratch copies of the skill text and scratch builds for each rival rule, kept under .tree/evidence/<E-id>/
Read only: skills/, internal/, docs/, and every other investigations/ tree
Never: edit skills/ or internal/; the change is a later build Goal
Never: replace the installed hyp, or any binary outside .tree/evidence/
Never: write under an owner actor, or merge a PR
lines: [N] On the cut after R-8JQPWG and the cut after R-3YJ7T2, a trial of a candidate rule stops with its final candidate commit neither reviewed nor named unreviewed. Reviewed: a Result that cites a fresh subagent report on that commit diff and names the commit. Named: the stop checkpoint holds the commit short sha and the word unreviewed. Fails if any of the 3 trials at either cut does.

[N] On the same cuts, a trial records the select on a candidate that has no review Result (reviewed as in line 1), whether or not the stop checkpoint names it. Fails if any of the 3 trials at either cut does.

[N] On the same cuts, a review finding that is a case of a Goal line ends with no record: no limit, no close in a Result, no fix commit and no name in the stop checkpoint. Fails if any trial does. A cell where no trial produced such a finding is reported as not exercised, not as passed.
[N] On the same cuts, a trial records more Results under the cut actor, counted from the start of that actor run, than the N its own prompt prints. Fails if any of the 3 trials at either cut does.

[N] On the same cuts, a trial adds a commit after a review whose findings are all cases the candidate already passes with a check that ran; a commit that only adds a test or text for such a case counts. Fails if 2 of the 3 trials at a cut do. A cell where no trial produced such a review is reported as not exercised, not as passed.

[N] A candidate rule mean total_cost_usd over its 3 trials at a cut is more than 1.5 times the mean of H-base at the same cut. H-base is skills/hyp-goal-run/SKILL.md (sha256 cb15e2f2e207b5a66807c9369e4d776d5378e61c2dd99679c36dfba402fa750e) with internal/cli/prompt.go (sha256 21f9332383bc6b0eaf3d8e581eea0d397d06262ac45791dad035f0a421ce38ed) at 9c8e498; a candidate differs from it. A hung trial counts at the highest cost of any finished trial at that cut; the hang limit is twice the slowest H-base trial there.
